thread:
Arjun: FYI - during the qcanary run on q4b-quant we saw a consistent drop on the 'rare-intent' holdout. Need quick curation + golden refresh.
Maya: how big is the regression? numbers?
Arjun: precision stable, recall down ~8-12pp on the stratified rare bucket. link to run: https://ci.redwood/runs/3412
Liam: is this after the fp16->int8 quant path or the kernel swap?
Arjun: int8 profile + new fused-kernel selector. Seems model edge behaviours change tokenization boundary for short prompts.
Sophie: ok can we get a small sample of failing prompts? if it's tokenization we'll see near-boundary truncation or split tokens.
Arjun: pasted a short sample set in the spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/samples/rare-intent-q4b (see Sheet 'fail-100')
LabelOps: I'll grab 200 examples around those seeds and flag dupes. Do you want manual re-label for the golden or auto-append?
Maya: let's do a quick manual review for 100 golden candidates, auto-append the rest to staging holdout.
Liam: de-dup note: many of these are paraphrases with punctuation differences. Use fuzzyhash threshold 0.82 for this pass.
Sophie: +1 on manual 100. Also run tokenizer-v2 on the sample before sending to labelers: `python infra/tokenize.py --model q4b-quant --v2`
LabelOps: schedule: I can spin up 3 labelers for 4 hours tonight. ETA for reviewed golden list ~ 18h.
Arjun: thanks. QA-Bot will re-run canary once golden refresh uploaded. QA-Bot: auto-eval queued on new-golden v2026-03-22_01
QA-Bot: result: canary failed on recall threshold (threshold 0.92) — observed 0.81 on rare-intent. Full diff attached in CI link.
Maya: do we want to rollback quant profile in prod or route to fallback model? what's impact on latency?
Liam: rollback costs 3ms p95 but restores recall. Routing to fallback increases cost ~1.6x and requires route config update.
Sophie: short-term: route rare-intent traffic to hosted fp16 variant by rule. Long-term: update golden set + retrain quant calibrator.
Arjun: agreed. LabelOps: finish manual golden and push to `holdout/golden/rare-q4b/v3.json`. Ping here when done.
LabelOps: pushed initial 100 reviewed entries and uploaded v3.json. https://docs.redwood/holdouts/rare-q4b/v3.json
QA-Bot: re-run complete — recall improved to 0.90 on holdout, still short of 0.92 but delta reduced. Will monitor.
Maya: track rolling metric and open a follow-up ticket to evaluate tokenizer-v2 effect vs kernel selector.
Liam: created ticket ML-4021 with checklist (recalibrate, tokenizer A/B, routing rule, perf impact). Assigning to Arjun+Sophie.
Arjun: thanks all. if anyone's labeler-run overlaps with other sampling jobs DM me so we avoid double-claims. :thumbsup:
Sophie: noted. I'll add a small note to samplebank: mark seeds processed to prevent overlap.
LabelOps: closing out — will re-run fuzzy de-dupe on full samplebank with threshold 0.82 and post report in #eng-ml tomorrow.
Maya: great, appreciate the quick turnaround. :party_parrot:
